metadata.question: In April 2023, did southern Spain experience temperatures over 90 degrees Fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about temperatures in southern Spain in April 2023, specifically whether temperatures exceeded 90°F. I need to: 1. Use temperature data - MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) would be appropriate 2. Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit 3. Check if any pixels exceeded 90°F 4. Handle potential data issues Strategy: - Use MODIS MOD11A2.061 (8-day LST) or MOD11A1.061 (daily LST) - Define southern Spain geometry (Andalusia region) - Filter for April 2023 - Convert LST from Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K × 9/5) - 459.67 - Check if maximum temperature exceeds 90°F - Handle potential data gaps with fallback options Data quality considerations: - Check collection size first - Check valid pixel count after masking - Validate temperature range (reasonable values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var southSpain = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-7.5, 36.0, -1.5, 38.5]); // Southern Spain region var startDate = '2023-04-01'; var endDate = '2023-04-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Land Surface Temperature var modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(southSpain) .select('LST_Day_1km'); var colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2023 MODIS images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS data found, trying MOD11A1..."); modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(southSpain) .select('LST_Day_1km'); colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2023 MOD11A1 images: ${colSize}`); } if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Convert LST from Kelvin to Fahrenheit var tempCollection = modisCol.map(function(image) { // Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K × 9/5) - 459.67 var tempF = image.multiply(0.02).multiply(9/5).subtract(459.67); // MODIS LST scale factor 0.02 return tempF.rename('temp_fahrenheit'); }); // Get maximum temperature composite for April var maxTemp = tempCollection.max(); // 4. Check for valid pixels and calculate stats var pixelCount = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southSpain, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temp_fahrenheit').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Get temperature statistics var tempStats = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: southSpain, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var meanTemp = tempStats.get('temp_fahrenheit_mean').getInfo(); var maxTempVal = tempStats.get('temp_fahrenheit_max').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean temp: ${meanTemp?.toFixed(1)}°F`); console.log(`Max temp: ${maxTempVal?.toFixed(1)}°F`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanTemp === null || maxTempVal === null || meanTemp === undefined || maxTempVal === undefined || maxTempVal < -100 || maxTempVal > 150) { // Validate temperature range console.log("C3"); } else if (maxTempVal > 90) { console.log(`Evidence: Maximum temperature ${maxTempVal.toFixed(1)}°F exceeds 90°F`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Evidence: Maximum temperature ${maxTempVal.toFixed(1)}°F below 90°F`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
